decisions.scenario: Refining a hotel search to a moderately priced east-side guesthouse and booking Carolina Bed and Breakfast

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'm looking for an expensive hotel with free parking.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I have several options. Do you prefer a particular area of the city?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'm looking for a guesthouse on the east side of town.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I'm afraid I don't have anything matching those specifications. Would you like to change the area, accommodation type, or price range?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Are there any moderately priced guesthouses in that part of town?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Yes. Carolina Bed and Breakfast and Warkworth House are both moderately priced guesthouses in the east. Would you like a room at one of them?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes. Could you check availability starting Tuesday for five nights for five people?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I've booked Carolina Bed and Breakfast for you starting Tuesday. Your reference number is BOHPJIFE.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thanks, that's great. I'm done for today.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You're welcome. Have a great day!

decisions.notes: Retained because the east-side guesthouse refinement and Tuesday booking for five people over five nights at Carolina Bed and Breakfast add a distinct booking task not present in reviewed authoring.

decisions.scenario: Booking the Lensfield Hotel for four people for three nights starting Thursday

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'm looking for an expensive hotel in the south.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The Lensfield Hotel matches that request. It has three stars and offers free Wi-Fi and parking. Would you like me to book a room?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: When will you arrive, how many nights would you like to stay, and how many people are in your party?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Please book it for four people for three nights starting Thursday.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Your booking was successful. The reference number is JCVMJBRZ.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thanks for your help. That's all I needed.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You're welcome. Have a great day!

decisions.notes: Retained because the Thursday three-night booking for four people at the Lensfield Hotel, including its booking reference, is distinct from reviewed Lensfield information-only coverage.
Rejected as a semantic near-duplicate of reviewed Huntingdon Marriott coverage, which already identifies the hotel as four-star with free parking and gives postcode PE29 6FL.
